summary: Abacus Global Management filed a routine Form 8-K reporting third-quarter 2026 results and declaring an ordinary annual dividend. The November 5, 2026 release cited record quarterly revenue of $76.9 million, adjusted net income of $29.4 million and adjusted EPS of $0.29, above the high end of guidance, with adjusted EBITDA of $42.3 million; full-year 2026 adjusted net income guidance was raised to $104.5–$106.5 million. The board approved a $0.22 per share annual cash dividend payable December 16, 2026 to holders of record December 1, 2026. No transaction, no advisor and no deal terms; no risk-arb angle.
